searchText: An update on our progress (we shared this in the core dev calls a few days ago): - MVP implementation just finished in geth, passing tests & we have an internal AA testnet to the spec Vitalik proposed here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/implementing-account-abstraction-as-part-of-eth1-x/4020. The current diff is here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/pull/13. We need to expand tests further and do some cleanup (WIP) but it is working at this point. - We are collecting data, performance metrics right now and will share results in due time. We are using https://github.com/lightclient/bazooka to stress test and send transactions across the wire. - We are currently creating AA transactions which use calldata to determine the # of loops (each 26 gas), whether the validation calls the `PAYGAS` opcode, and what gas price is called via `PAYGAS` - We are now starting brainstorming sessions to begin discussion on expanding beyond the initial MVP to support multiple txs per account, proxy patterns, and other improvements Yay! The contract for these AA transactions is here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/pull/13/files#diff-2ebab6769b19eeb122463079d8c9db24R35 - we'll start working on more practical contracts/usecases soon.

An update on our progress (we shared this in the core dev calls a few days ago):
- MVP implementation just finished in geth, passing tests & we have an internal AA testnet to the spec Vitalik proposed here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/implementing-account-abstraction-as-part-of-eth1-x/4020. 
The current diff is here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/pull/13. We need to expand tests further and do some cleanup (WIP) but it is working at this point.
- We are collecting data, performance metrics right now and will share results in due time. We are using https://github.com/lightclient/bazooka to stress test and send transactions across the wire.
- We are currently creating AA transactions which use calldata to determine the # of loops (each 26 gas), whether the validation calls the `PAYGAS` opcode, and what gas price is called via  `PAYGAS`
- We are now starting brainstorming sessions to begin discussion on expanding beyond the initial MVP to support multiple txs per account, proxy patterns, and other improvements
